scope: real Chrome IndexedDB with simulated business API; no real server, no App GUI assertion
checks: a complete direct DELETE DTO commits terminal cleanup and notifies visible holders before returning without rewriting Outbox
a forward response started before a new global fact cannot reopen its pre-delete projection
known terminals mask later exact-read and paged search bodies even when their owner version is higher
malformed business tombstones and raw sync pages cannot add trusted global facts
repeating a terminal does not keep invalidating projections and a later exact read can restore an unaffected forward
a full tombstone must match the original message route or conversation filter and original write client ID before permanent cleanup
an in-flight private attachment cannot publish bytes after a newer global observation
private media rereads shared durable facts before returning even when the peer writer has not published to this module
